name: giftmemory
description: GiftMemory – Thoughtful Gift Planner (React + Node.js/Express + MongoDB)
author: Dakshitha Sree

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix client --include=dev && npm run build --prefix client && npm install --prefix server --omit=dev
